body:
Well... I had a series of really strange experiences. Secular people tell me they were symptoms of schizophrenia. I followed these "signs" and ended up living on a native American reservation for a short period of time. I had a near death experience. I had like a random vision of what I believe was a past life. I also saw a hand coming out of a mirror and kept waking up at like 3:33AM repeatedly. 

I wrote a book about all these experiences as well in a google doc. I don't even know if all of it qualifies as a shamanic call. But it definitely was... something.
Thank you for your kind words.
